QuestInfo.name: [Black Wings] Unpleasant Mechanical Doll
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #bWatchman #p2154006##k who guards the #b#m310050200##k in the Mine.
QuestInfo.1:
Watchman #p2154006# says he, too, was in #m310050400#, but left because he didn't want to live next to Androids. Apparently, he hates them because he doesn't think they have real feelings.

He says he's curious whether Androids would get scared of creepy things, so he wants you to catch some #r#o7150001# enemies#k and show their #bTentacles#k to #bAndroid #p2154007##k.

#i4000610# #t4000610# #b#c4000610#/30#k
QuestInfo.2: #p2154007# wasn't bothered by the #t4000610# at all.

0.0: Huh? Who are you? Are you new? Not many Black Wing members come here, since there's not much to do. It's a little creepy, sure, but it's also nice and relaxing. It's great, except for one thing...
0.1: I'm actually supposed by standing guard inside the mine shafts but I really don't like the guys inside. I don't want to be near them. Their expressionless faces really creep me out. Hm, I can tell from your bewildered look that you have no idea what I'm talking about. You really are new. I'm talking about the #bandroids#k.
0.2: They may be expensive pieces of technology created by that genius scientist, but at the end of the day, they're little more than machine puppets. It irks me to think that they get treated better than human beings. And they act like they're so superior. Maybe we should play a little prank on them. You wanna help?

yes.0: Let's find out if those androids really don't have any emotions. You can get #b#t4000610# items#k by hunting #r#o7150001# enemies#k. Get about #b30#k of those and show them to the #bandroid #p2154007##k inside #bm310050400##k. See if he doesn't get scared of something so disgusting.

no.0: What? You think it's lame? Yeah, I guess it kind of is. Still, it's so boring here without anything to do.

1.0: Based on the location and your outfit, I surmise that you are a new member of the Black Wings. What can I do for you? You want my hand? I'm sorry, my hand as it is currently in use. No? You want me to hold out my hands? Please do not use ambiguous statements.

yes.0: Based on size, form, and smell, I surmise that the items you gave me are #t4000610#s. I do not comprehend the meaning behind your actions but my programming suggests that I say thank you. Thank you.

npc.0: Have you not gotten the #b30 #t4000610# items#k yet? I really want to know how the androids will react to those disgusting things. Get them quickly, and show them to #b#p2154007##k.

item.0: Based on the location and your outfit, I surmise that you are a new Black Wing member. Please do not deviate from your mission. I cannot determine your mission. Please talk to #p2154006#, who is is charge at the First Square.
